en.hubeali:
Humeyd Bin Ziyad,f rom Ibn Sama’at, from someone else, from Aban Bin Usman, from Misma’a, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ibrahim<sup>asws</sup> (7<sup>th</sup> Imam<sup>asws</sup>) having said:

‘Myasws fatherasws used to view for these two Harrams what heasws did not view for other than these two, and heasws was saying: ‘The complete (Salaat) in these two is from the matters of the preserved treasures’.
en.sarwar: 7. Humayd ibn Ziyad from ibn Sama‘ah from more than one person from Aban ibn ‘Uthman from Misma’ who has said the following: “Abu Ibrahim, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘

My father, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, would see for these two al- Haram (the sacred area) what he would not see for other places and say that performing Salat (prayer) therein in complete form is of the saving matters.’”
